comment: The README says the four channels are normalled, so a row with an empty IN jack takes the row above. With 'SUM chans to poly out #1:' set, only the first channel of each row's polyphony is summed into output 1, and the other three outputs carry their rows as usual; the panel marks that output with an S in a pink circle. The twelve note buttons and the SCALE and PROG knobs are shared by all four rows.
